pipeline: PyTorch QAT -> ONNX QDQ (INT8) -> NXP eiq-onnx2tflite --qdq-aware-conversion -> INT8 TFLite
summary: QDQ-preserving conversion (Path B). Translates the ONNX per-tensor INT8 scales/zero-points 1:1 into TFLite quantization params. No re-calibration, so accuracy is preserved exactly.

comparison_onnx2tf_path_a.note: onnx2tf re-runs its own INT8 calibration and discards the QAT/ORT scales -> catastrophic drift

deployment_caveat.issue: GELU exports an Erf op with no native TFLite kernel -> 3 FlexErf (TF Select) ops
deployment_caveat.impact: Runs under desktop TF runtime (used for validation); NOT supported by TFLite-Micro on the MCU
deployment_caveat.fix: Retrain with tanh-approximation GELU so the activation lowers to native TANH; QDQ translation accuracy is unaffected
